question: How many calendar years passed between Sir John Pawlett's lease of most of Westover to Theodorick Bland and the conveyance of 1,200 acres by Theodorick and Richard Bland to William Byrd I?
criterion: the lease of most of Westover to Theodorick Bland and the Blands' conveyance of 1,200 acres to William Byrd I, two named events
why_needs_multiple: Hỏi khoảng cách năm giữa hai mốc được nêu tên nên cần cả hai ngày. (thêm tay sau khi nới luật order_gap)
